outputs.discrepancies: The caption sentence for the MARCM clone images reads 'MARCM clones of WT (G), sin1 (H), and rictor (J) are shown', labeling the rictor clone panel as (J). However, the actual panel showing the rictor MARCM clone is labeled (I) in the figure (panel J is instead the first quantification bar chart, 'Total branch length'). The panel image itself correctly shows a rictor MARCM clone, but the caption's panel letter for it is wrong, creating a mismatch between the caption text and the figure's panel labeling.
